rootCauses.problem: Application claim identifiers were placed in publicOutputSchemaId; the authoritative M6 policy accepts decision-receipt-v1.

rootCauses.regression: All three profiles project through the unchanged M6 policy; exact application claim lists and counts are preserved.

rootCauses.problem: The purchasing template declares a state transition but selected the non-transitioning delegated-capability-action module.
rootCauses.fix: Select the existing private-state-transition-v1 family, which also enforces delegated authorization.
rootCauses.regression: The compiled M6 runtimeActionNextState rejected the previous module and accepts every corrected template transition.

rootCauses.problem: The emergency fixture issued a 690-second root capability against a 300-second template limit.
rootCauses.fix: Cap generated root capability lifetime at the template rule and cap its session expiry accordingly.
rootCauses.regression: Every generated flow window stays within its template duration; the emergency root lifetime is 300 seconds.
